searchText: Is it correct to say that BPO HFs do not yet have a "place to live" so that one could reference spec (params/date) in a stable way? If so I find this unlucky and I think we should adjust here. <@412614104222531604> ^ wdym? they are defined in the meta EIP: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7607 as well as genesis file: https://github.com/eth-clients/mainnet/blob/main/metadata/genesis.json#L41 They also live in the consensus specs: * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/master/specs/fulu/beacon-chain.md#blob-schedule * https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/39205edd3c667e8a97a378ad8976453a8d776049/configs/mainnet.yaml#L238-L245 Yeah, hmm, but as-by-design BPOs should be HF-independent, right? 🤔 So it can/will likely be that there will be independent post-Fusaka BPOs. So it is suboptimal to spec-bundle them with the Meta-EIP from the respective HF. I think it would be better to have a small dedicated spec document for them. And if it is small dedicated EIP (does not need to be long). https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7892 We have this. I'm talking about specific BPO hard forks, not the "BPO as as concept" document can you add a comment to the next ACDC agenda? if y'all come to consensus on a solution here, can just be an FYI in the call <https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1790>

excerpts.author: holgerd77
excerpts.content:

I think it would be better to have a small dedicated spec document for them. And if it is small dedicated EIP (does not need to be long).
